summary: Bland County, VA lookout at 1,147 m; FFLOS-registered 2010 as US 698; tower gone, four concrete footers and a 20-ft section remain; no build or staffing data found.

facts.status_note: Register says the tower is gone; four concrete footers, concrete steps and one 20-foot section of tower remain; Forest Lookouts lists it as removed

events.note: Registered October 25, 2010 as US 698, VA 3; nominated by Dan East

evidence.supports: four concrete footers and concrete steps remain
evidence.quote: all that remains are the four concrete footers and the concrete steps to which the metal stairs were anchored

evidence.supports: one 20-foot section mounted on one of the footers
evidence.quote: One section (20') of standard tower was mounted to one of the footers.
No antenna remains on the tower.

evidence.supports: guy wires are holding the section up
evidence.quote: There are guide wires holding it up.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts lists it under Bland County
Forest Lookouts marks the tower as removed

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, staffing or fire record appears in the two sources read, and two web searches found none for this Virginia site. Searches for High Rock also return unrelated High Rock Lookouts in Washington State (Gifford Pinchot National Forest, Lewis County); do not conflate them. Elevation in the brief (1146.7 m) matches the register. Public access is not described anywhere, so no access fact is recorded. The brief's status 'gone' matches the register and Forest Lookouts ('Removed').
